thread:
marisol: Quick sync — follow-ups from the 2026-03-10 postmortem. We need concrete owners + Jira links for the outstanding remediation items (esp. the auth token spikes). Can we lock owners and target dates today? :spiral_calendar:

luke: I can own the token-rotation work. I'll open ENG-6219 and link it to the PM postmortem. ETA: 2026-03-19. Will add acceptance criteria and a small rollout plan.

jia: I'll take the monitoring/playbook updates (ENG-6220). Will add runbook steps, alerts, and escalation paths.

mike: I'll handle the customer-facing comms and internal process docs. Creating DOC-442 and will tag @sre for review.

sara: For RACI, propose: Luke (R), Jia (A), SRE (C), Product (I). Is that acceptable?

luke: I agree overall but prefer SRE to be A on the monitoring runbook (they operate the alerts). Jia can be R for authoring. Small RACI snapshot below:

```
Item: monitoring runbook
R: jia
A: eng-sre (oncall/ops)
C: luke, product
I: customers, support
```

marisol: @ops-bot can you link ENG-6219 and ENG-6220 to PM-383 (postmortem ticket)? Also flag any unassigned items.

ops-bot: Linked ENG-6219, ENG-6220 to PM-383. Current status: ENG-6219 = To Do (unstarted), ENG-6220 = In Progress. Reminder set for 2026-03-15 to check progress.

mike: Tentative milestones: start 2026-03-15, internal review 2026-03-18, close 2026-03-25. I'll add milestones to DOC-442 and ENG-6219/6220.

jia: One technical decision: do we keep the fallback model variant in the deploy policy? That affects rollout testing and can change blast radius.

marisol: Yes, keep fallback. Luke, please note the fallback variant in ENG-6219 and add a short validation checklist.

luke: Noted: fallback -> small-quantized-v1. Adding validation steps and perf thresholds to ENG-6219.

sara: Also capturing a recurring pattern: auth spike around 02:00 UTC weekly (observed 3 weeks in a row). Can we add a scheduled load check to the playbook?

jia: I'll add a scheduled synthetic check at 01:50 UTC daily for two weeks after the fix, and an alert if baseline deviates >20%.

marisol: Good. Final ask: owners + JIRA links or docs by EOD today. If items remain unassigned after EOD we'll rota ownership to oncall and escalate. :thumbsup:

luke: ack :thumbsup:

mike: ack, will update links before EOD.

marisol: Thanks team — I'll follow up in the PM ticket with a summary and check the milestones tomorrow morning.
